* Integrate AI models and services through APIs, including cloud-based AI platforms.
* Work with relational and NoSQL databases, data processing pipelines, and external service integrations.
* Develop efficient, maintainable, secure, and scalable code following software engineering best practices.
* Perform debugging, testing, performance optimization, and deployment of applications.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand requirements and deliver AI-driven business solutions.
* Explore emerging AI technologies and contribute to technical innovation and continuous improvement.

**Required Technical Skills**
-----------------------------

### **1. Full-Stack Development**

* Strong programming skills in Python.
* Hands-on experience with at least one Python backend framework: FastAPI, Flask, or Django.
* Experience building REST APIs, integrating third-party services, and implementing backend business logic.
* Working knowledge of React.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3, or an equivalent modern frontend framework.
* Understanding of frontend-backend integration, authentication, application architecture, and state management.

### **2. Machine Learning and Deep Learning**

* Understanding of core Machine Learning concepts, including supervised and unsupervised learning, classification, regression, clustering, and model evaluation.
* Familiarity with Deep Learning concepts and neural network architectures.
* Hands-on experience with libraries such as Scikit-learn, PyTorch, or TensorFlow.
* Knowledge of data preprocessing, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, and inference.

### **3. Generative AI and LLM Applications**

* Hands-on experience building applications using LLMs from providers such as OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, or other equivalent platforms.
* Understanding of prompt engineering, structured outputs, function/tool calling, and context management.
* Experience implementing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines.
* Familiarity with embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, and document processing.
* Understanding of LLM evaluation, hallucination mitigation, and response quality optimization.

### **4. Agentic AI and AI Workflows**

* Understanding of AI agents, tool calling, workflow orchestration, and state management.
* Familiarity with frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or equivalent technologies.
* Knowledge of multi-agent systems, planning, task decomposition, and tool integration.
* Ability to build AI workflows that interact with APIs, databases, and external systems.
* Understanding of agent evaluation, error handling, observability, and reliable execution.

### **5. Databases, Cloud, and Deployment**

* Working knowledge of SQL databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL.
* Familiarity with NoSQL databases and vector databases.
* Understanding of Git, version control, debugging, and testing.
* Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD, and application deployment.
* Exposure to cloud platform (Microsoft Azure).
* Understanding of application security, logging, monitoring, and performance optimization.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 2+ years of relevant software engineering or AI application development experience.
* Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently, learn new technologies quickly, and collaborate effectively with a team.
* Strong communication skills and a willingness to take ownership of assigned tasks.

  

**DISCLAIMER AND NOTIFICATION**

We (C5i) do not charge/accept any amount or security deposit from job seekers during the selection process or while inviting candidates for an interview.

title: Post-Doctoral Fellow - Materials Science
description:
GE Vernova Advanced Research is seeking a motivated Postdoctoral Research Fellow to advance our computational and experimental capabilities. This role focuses on bridging the gap between fundamental materials modeling and industrial application. The successful candidate will apply multiscale physics to predict the performance and degradation of high-temperature structural materials, including Ni-based superalloys and Thermal Barrier Coatings (TBCs), as well as various energy-related materials. The role involves integrating simulation insights with experimental validation to drive the development of next-generation materials, including the optimization of existing materials for critical supply chains and the design of novel manufacturing pathways.This is a fixed term position for 9 months.

**Job Description**
===================

**This role focuses on bridging the gap between fundamental materials modeling and industrial application. The successful candidate will apply multiscale physics to predict the performance and degradation of high-temperature structural materials, including Ni-based superalloys and Thermal Barrier Coatings (TBCs), as well as various energy-related materials. The role involves integrating simulation insights with experimental validation to drive the development of next-generation materials, including the optimization of existing materials for critical supply chains and the design of novel manufacturing pathways.**

  

**Roles and Responsibilities**

  

* **Develop and execute continuum-scale models to simulate material performance, transport phenomena, and degradation kinetics.**
* **Partner with laboratory teams to characterize material properties, validate model inputs, and correlate simulation predictions with empirical data from in-house tests.**
* **Apply your knowledge in Mechanical & Materials engineering to work on innovative solutions for the GE Vernova product portfolio.**
* **Learn required tools/processes and perform advanced simulations, validating models against published external results and in-house experimental data.**
* **Deliver on assigned project tasks with minimal guidance, document results, and provide actionable insights for material optimization.**
* **Collaborate with the team to improve materials management, evaluate existing materials for critical supply chains, and enhance sustainability for GE Vernova products.**
* **Perform literature surveys and assess the state-of-the-art landscape in material technologies, design, and manufacturing to guide R&D project direction.**
* **Apply AI/ML techniques to map processing-structure-property relationships to accelerate the discovery and improvement of advanced materials.**
* **Utilize atomistic simulations as a complementary tool to resolve fine-scale mechanisms that inform and refine larger-scale models.**
* **Apply systems thinking to understand the impact of material behavior at the component and system levels and actively participate in team efforts to achieve collective project goals.**
  

**Required Qualifications**

  

* **Education: Recently completed Ph.D/Submitted Ph.D Thesis, in Materials Science, Metallurgy, or a related field ing (< 11 months post completion of Ph.D Defense)**
  

* **Modeling Expertise:**
  + **Advanced proficiency in continuum modeling software, specifically COMSOL Multiphysics, and experience with other relevant commercial or open-source simulation packages.**
  + **Demonstrated experience in property prediction models and thermodynamic/kinetic modeling (e.g., CALPHAD).**
  + **Proficiency in Python for scientific programming, data processing, and model automation.**
  + **Experience applying AI/ML techniques for material property prediction and design optimization.**
  + **Familiarity with atomistic simulation methods (e.g., DFT, MD) to supplement continuum studies.**
* **Experimental Background: Proven experience in a laboratory setting with the ability to interpret characterization data to inform modeling parameters.**
* **Domain Knowledge: Solid foundation in metallurgy and high-temperature materials. Familiarity with energy materials, fuel cells, or energy storage technologies is an asset. Expertise in material design and manufacturing processes.**
* **Communication: Strong ability to collaborate across multidisciplinary teams and articulate complex technical findings to diverse stakeholders.**
  

* Excellent oral and written communication skills
  

* Demonstrated ability to work independently and in a team environment and accountability/ownership of assigned tasks
  

* Demonstrated ability to take up challenging assignments and deliver.
  

* Passion to innovate and creative problem solving
  

* Ability to do a State-of-the-Art Survey on and awareness/engagement with leading research groups globally in the assigned areas and synthesis the findings.
  

**Desired Characteristics**

  

* **Experience with advanced modeling techniques such as phase-field or crystal plasticity.**
* **Understanding of challenges related to material availability and design strategies for critical supply chains.**
* **Self-motivated with a strong track record of peer-reviewed publications and conference presentations.**
* **Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a team-based environment, with a commitment to cross-functional collaboration and systems-level problem solving.**
  

  
  
  

**Additional Information**
==========================

**Relocation Assistance Provided:** Yes

title: Senior Software Development Engineer
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

  

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

**Introduction to team:**

Data is central to how Expedia Group operates, serves travelers, and makes decisions. When data is incomplete, inaccurate, delayed, or difficult to interpret, the impact can extend across products, analytics, operations, and customer experiences.

The Data Quality Platform team is responsible for building a centralized, scalable, and extensible platform that helps teams proactively understand, validate, and trust their data across batch and streaming datasets. We provide automated profiling, configurable quality rules, data contracts, anomaly detection, incident workflows, alerting, and data health visibility so data producers can identify and resolve issues closer to the source.

We focus on building reliable, high-performance, secure, and cost-effective platform services that integrate with data pipelines and analytical systems. Typical technologies include Java, Kotlin, Spring, REST, gRPC, Amazon Web Services, Spark, Kafka, Airflow, and Agentic AI. We encourage experimentation with new technologies, including machine-assisted data quality workflows, while balancing short- and long-term goals and maintaining a high bar for platform quality and operational excellence.

  

As a Senior SDE, you will set the technical direction for core Data Quality Platform services and drive their design, delivery, and operation end to end. You will be a hands-on technical leader—writing and reviewing code, shaping architecture across data profiling, quality rules, data contracts, anomaly detection, alerting, and data health experiences, and raising the engineering bar for the team. Your work will directly determine how effectively engineering, analytics, and data teams across Expedia Group can trust and act on their data at scale.

  

**In this role, you will:**

* Design, build, and maintain complex, highly available Data Quality Platform services and applications, including robust system design (low-level design), API design (REST/gRPC), and data modeling across batch and streaming domains.
* Lead end-to-end delivery of features and services—from technical design and implementation through deployment, monitoring, and ongoing optimization in production—spanning profiling, quality rules, data contracts, anomaly detection, incident workflows, and alerting.
* Improve technical quality and operational excellence by driving code quality standards, reducing incidents, strengthening observability, and optimizing performance, reliability, and cost of high-throughput data systems.
* Mentor and guide other engineers, sharing best practices in software engineering, testing, and distributed-systems architecture, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement and learning.
* Collaborate with product, architecture, data platform teams, and data domain owners to translate business and data-trust problems into scalable technical solutions that can be reused across domains.
Safely integrate and operate AI/ML-enabled and machine-assisted capabilities that improve rule authoring, anomaly detection, and issue explanation, applying AI/ML concepts to practical data platform workflows.  

  

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; or equivalent related professional experience.
* 8+ years of professional backend software development experience in an object-oriented language (e.g., Java, Kotlin, or similar).
* Proven experience owning end-to-end delivery for services or components—including design, implementation, testing, deployment, and support—within a multi-service or domain environment.
* Strong proficiency in at least one modern programming language and core software engineering practices, including object-oriented design, data structures, algorithms, testing, and version control.
Hands-on experience designing and consuming APIs, working with data models and storage systems, and applying system design principles to build reliable and maintainable systems.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience designing and evolving service and application architectures for high-traffic, distributed systems, including clear API contracts, data models, and low-level designs.
* Track record of designing and evolving high-throughput data systems, including integration with batch or streaming pipelines (e.g., Spark, Kafka, Airflow) and backward-compatible APIs.
* Experience working with data platforms, data quality, data observability, data pipelines, data contracts, or analytics systems, or a closely related domain.
* Demonstrated track record driving technical direction for services or domains, making data-informed tradeoffs on scalability, reliability, performance, and cost.
* Strong focus on operational excellence, including monitoring, alerting, incident response, SRE practices, and continuous improvement of production systems and developer workflows.
* Familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real-world products, including safely integrating AI/ML-enabled features into existing services.
* Experience leading cross-team technical initiatives or migrations, influencing engineering best practices across a domain, and mentoring others to grow their technical depth and delivery capability—including guiding teams on effective and responsible use of AI-assisted development and testing tools.

**Accommodation requests**

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job\_accommodation .

  

**About Expedia Group**

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

  

**Important notice**

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/ .

  

**Equal Opportunity**

Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.

description:

* Automate workflows, processes, and system tasks to improve reliability, efficiency, scalability, and operational consistency.

One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with customers in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important-you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused-someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless-naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

Required skills and experience
  

* 8+ years of experience and deep expertise within specific technology domain areas (e.g., software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics)

* Hands-on experience in at least one of the following: software development, DevOps engineering, systems administration, or systems architecture in public cloud AWS domain
* In-depth knowledge of Windows and Linux Operating System

  
Preferred skills and experience
  

* Familiar with a variety of IT concepts, practices, and procedures
* Knowledge of design techniques, tools, and principals involved in production of precision technical plans, blueprints, drawings, and models
* Logic and reasoning to identify the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions, or approaches to problems
* Analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. title: Senior AI Evals Engineer
description:
**About the Role**
------------------

The **Senior AI Evals Test Engineer** is a hands-on technical role responsible for defining, developing, and executing robust evaluation frameworks and test strategies for AI agents built using the **Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) or similar sort of agentic frameworks**. This role bridges AI development and reliable deployment — ensuring our agents are safe, ethical, effective, and meet high-quality performance standards. A significant focus of the role is on Responsible AI and Safety Evals, including **adversarial testing, red-teaming, bias detection, and toxicity measurement**. The engineer will **design scalable evaluation pipelines**, build synthetic test environments, and work closely with AI/ML Engineers, Researchers, and policy teams to ensure agents are production-ready and compliant with regulatory and ethical standards. The role is **70% Automation and 30% Manual Testing**, and sits within the **Applied AI: Test Engineering team** as a key technical authority.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Design and build agent evaluation frameworks** — create end-to-end infrastructure for evaluating LLM-based agents across correctness, latency, cost, safety, and task completion rate
* **Build synthetic testing environments and simulation strategies** to stress-test AI agents under diverse real-world conditions, with specific focus on agents built on Google ADK and related Google AI/ML services (e.g., Vertex AI, Gemini models)
* **Build golden datasets and test harnesses** — curate domain-specific evaluation sets for Rubrik's product verticals (data security, SaaS protection, cyber recovery, compliance)
* **Establish eval-as-a-service** — build and enhance centralized evaluation platform that any IT team members can self-serve to test their agents against standardized and custom benchmarks
* **Automate regression and drift detection** — implement CI/CD-integrated eval pipelines that catch regressions on every model or prompt change before production deployment
* **Define eval taxonomies and rubrics** — establish structured scoring criteria for agentic workflows (tool use accuracy, multi-step reasoning, hallucination rate, policy adherence, error recovery)
* **Instrument production observability** — build real-time monitoring for agent quality in production: success rates, user corrections, fallback triggers, escalation patterns
* **Benchmark and select models** — run structured model comparisons (cost, quality, latency trade-offs) to inform model selection decisions across agent use cases
* **Analyze and interpret evaluation results**, providing clear, actionable quality and safety reports to stakeholders and development teams, with specific focus on risk metrics, trend analysis, and mitigation recommendations
* **Define comprehensive end-to-end QA strategies** — functional, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing (UAT) — tailored for conversational and goal-oriented AI agents with tool-use, memory, and multi-turn reasoning capabilities
* **Develop and maintain detailed test artifacts** (test plans, test cases, test scenarios, automated test suites) covering agent features, tool invocation, memory persistence, and reasoning accuracy across evolving model versions
* **Identify, document, prioritize, and track defects**, performance regressions, and alignment failures using Jira, collaborating closely with Applied AI Engineers to analyze root causes and validate fixes
* **Evaluate new technologies and patterns** (e.g., new tools for Agent Evals), run proofs-of-concept, and influence the platform roadmap
* **Partner with policy and legal teams** to ensure agent evaluations systematically cover regulatory compliance, fairness objectives, and emerging AI governance requirements
* **Provide technical leadership to engineers**, including solutioning, design reviews, code reviews, pair programming, and mentoring of junior and contract engineers
* **Collaborate cross-functionally** — work closely with ML engineers, product teams, platform engineers, and security to embed eval-driven quality gates into the agent development lifecycle

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

### **Education & Experience**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
* **8+ years of overall software Test engineering experience**, with 5+ years focused on test engineering, QA automation, or developer tooling, and demonstrated ability to build evaluation systems across multiple AI/ML domains, conversational agents, or Large Language Models (LLMs)
* **2+ years working with ML/AI systems, building**, testing, or evaluating models in production environments, including hands-on experience with LLM-based applications, prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, or agentic workflows
* **2+ years as a senior/lead, owning evaluation strategy,** quality frameworks, and technical decisions for complex AI agent systems in an enterprise product environment
* **1+ years** in designing or operating evaluation frameworks specifically for generative AI / LLM agents, including benchmarking, red-teaming, and production quality monitoring in the AI ADLC model

### **Technical Skills**

* **Deep hands-on experience with LLM evaluation** — familiarity with frameworks and libraries such as LangSmith, DeepEval,LLM as a Judge, Promptfoo, RAGAS, Hugging Face evaluation tooling, custom eval harnesses
* **Strong understanding of agentic AI patterns** — tool use, function calling, multi-step planning, ReAct/CoT reasoning chains, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)
* **Production experience with eval pipelines** — building automated, CI-integrated evaluation infrastructure (not just notebooks)
* **Proficiency in Python** — strong scripting and tooling skills; experience with pytest, async patterns, and data processing at scale
* **Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or any Cloud Service** relevant to AI/ML (e.g., Vertex AI) and experience integrating testing into MLOps workflows
* **Statistical literacy** — ability to design experiments, interpret eval metrics with appropriate confidence, and avoid common pitfalls (overfitting to benchmarks, metric gaming)
* **Enterprise product sensibility** — understanding of how AI quality translates to customer trust in a B2B/enterprise context (security, compliance, reliability SLAs)
* **Excellent communication** — ability to present eval results and quality trade-offs to engineering leadership, articulate risks and safety findings to non-technical audiences, and drive alignment on ship/no-ship decisions
* **Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and Git-based workflows**, including automated testing, static analysis, deployment automation, and environment configuration for our DevTestOps

### **Tech Stack:**

* **Languages:** Python(Must), TypeScript, Java (Optional)
* **Test Automation:Selenium, Playwright**
* **LLM Providers:** Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, open-source models

description:

title: Director, Product Design
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
Why This Role Is Different
  
JLL is one of the world's leading professional services firms specializing in real estate and investment management, operating across 80+ countries. Our Corporate Functions Technologies (CFT) Finance team is at the forefront of transforming how JLL manages its global financial operations — and this role sits at the heart of that transformation.
  
**Here's what makes this different:** Most Order-to-Cash roles are ERP configuration and steady-state delivery. This one isn't. As Director of O2C Product Design with AI Innovation, you will shape the design and strategy of one of the first agentic AI transformations inside JLL's finance technology organization — systems that make invoicing, collections, and cash-application decisions autonomously, not just execute fixed rules.
  
As a key member of our existing O2C product focused team and working in conjunction with our JLL finance teams and our external delivery and vendor partners your role will be responsible for the delivery of various enhancements across O2C delivering the evolution of JLL's billing, accounts receivable, and contract management capabilities across our global PeopleSoft FSCM 9.2 platform.
  
As a subject matter expert, you will own design authority before delivery — signing off that AI/integration initiatives are properly designed for business value and enterprise robustness before they enter build, not after. And you'll do this with direct exposure to senior Finance Technology leadership and meaningful influence over JLL's Accelerate 2030 strategic programme.
  
If you want to design a real, production-scale case study in enterprise agentic AI at a Fortune 500 global services company, this is where it's happening.
  
  
About the Team
  
The CFT O2C team is responsible for the end-to-end product strategy, design, and delivery of JLL's Order to Cash platform — spanning contracts, billing, accounts receivable, and third-party integrations across a single global PeopleSoft FSCM 9.2 ERP instance.
  
The team supports core finance operations across 60+ countries and works closely with Finance, Engineering, and Production Support to deliver continuous improvement and strategic transformation at global scale. This role is a named contributor to JLL's Accelerate 2030/Enterprise Business Objectives (EBO) strategy, with direct accountability against the platform-modernization and data/AI pillars.
  
What's Different at Director Level
  
This role carries distinct authority and scope compared to senior product or delivery roles:
  
Design authority before delivery — you own the design roadmap and sign off that AI/integration initiatives are properly designed for business value and enterprise robustness before they enter build, not after
  
Cross-portfolio scope — spans billing/order processing, accounts receivable, and third-party integrations, rather than one workstream
  
Build-vs-buy decision authority — make and defend recommendations on AI and automation tooling, with clear input to procurement decisions and alignment with our Finance partners and Delivery partners
  
Direct leadership visibility — present design and investment roadmaps to senior Finance Technology leadership directly
  
Transformation leadership — guide the organization through AI-enabled process redesign, not just system configuration
  
Strategic Context
  
This role supports the O2C modernization program currently underway across billing, accounts receivable, and integration workstreams — translating strategy into a coherent design roadmap where AI and integration initiatives are proven out for business value before entering delivery.
  
You will operate at the intersection of finance operations, enterprise technology, and AI innovation, with significant input to how JLL deploys agentic automation across financial processes that directly impact working capital, revenue assurance, and client experience.
  
What You Will Do
  
1. Product Strategy & Design Leadership
  
Support the end-to-end O2C product design strategy — from concept through launch and iteration — grounding every design decision in measurable business benefit
  
Direct the design, modification, and evaluation of O2C solutions across the portfolio (billing, accounts receivable, third-party integrations), guiding teams toward well-defined, optimal outcomes
  
Partner with Product Owners and Product Support in balancing current-state support with forward design work
  
Build and maintain a performance framework that provides visibility into design quality, process efficiency, and business value delivered
  
Present strategic roadmaps and investment cases to Finance Technology leadership and O2C Steering Committee
  
2. Order to Cash & Order-to-Billing Design
  
Guide design of core O2C enhancements including contract asset handling, credit note automation, and client onboarding, ensuring solutions meet requirements with minimal post-deployment defects
  
Identify and prioritize opportunities to streamline billing and contract processes through digitization and automation design, including agentic AI capabilities
  
Ensure all design decisions support financial close, month-end reporting, and revenue assurance requirements across 60+ countries
  
Design solutions that maintain compliance with regional regulatory requirements and internal controls
  
3. AI, Agentic Automation & Integration Design
  
This is the core differentiator of this role
  
Research and propose GenAI use cases across O2C — intelligent cash application, proactive collections optimization, automated dispute resolution, working-capital forecasting — each backed by a feasibility assessment on JLL's internal data/AI platform, validated with Engineering
  
Build ROI-based business cases for GenAI and automation initiatives in partnership with Finance operations partners, demonstrating measurable impact on DSO, dispute resolution time, and working capital
  
Make and defend build-vs-buy decisions on AI and automation tooling, with clear recommendations on vendor selection, platform integration, and total cost of ownership
  
Extend agentic workflow design across integration touchpoints — including invoicing and remittance automation with third-party systems (payment gateways, banks, treasury platforms, CRM systems) — from concept to production
  
Present AI and automation recommendations, with a prioritized roadmap, to Finance Technology leadership
  
Partner with Enterprise Data & AI teams to assess technical feasibility of AI initiatives and ensure alignment with enterprise AI governance standards
  
4. Governance, Compliance & Controls
  
Apply audit and compliance principles (including SOX) to the design of billing and revenue-related workflows
  
Ensure design deliverables support timely resolution of priority O2C issues and minimize post-deployment errors
  
Maintain design documentation to the standard required for audit and compliance purposes
  
Design AI/automation solutions that preserve appropriate financial controls and audit trails
  
Participate in monthly O2C Steering Committee and quarterly CFT Portfolio Review governance forums
  
What We Are Looking For
  
Required
  
10+ years' experience with a major ERP finance platform supporting Order-to-Cash operations, with strong preference for PeopleSoft FSCM 9.2
  
**Deep functional expertise across the O2C lifecycle:** contracts, billing, accounts receivable, credit management, collections, cash application and demonstrate experience of delivering change that have delivered tangible benefits
  
Strong understanding of financial close, month-end reporting, and revenue assurance processes in a global, multi-entity environment
  
Experience contributing to at least one global ERP rollout or large-scale finance transformation program
  
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with demonstrated ability to engage and influence senior finance and technology stakeholders
  
Proven experience scoping, validating, and deploying AI/ML or automation use cases in finance operations, with ability to provide specific examples of business value delivered
  
  
Preferred
  
Hands-on experience with Generative AI tools and platforms (e.g., Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, Oracle AI DP/Apex) in an enterprise finance context
  
Familiarity with agentic workflow frameworks (such as LangChain, AutoGen, or similar orchestration tools)
  
Experience implementing AI solutions subject to financial controls and SOX requirements, with understanding of explainability and auditability needs
  
Working knowledge of cloud-based AI/data platform capabilities and enterprise integration patterns
  
PeopleSoft or Oracle certification/accreditation
  
Change management or transformation leadership experience, particularly in introducing AI/automation capabilities to finance operations teams
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  
Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:
  
  
JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  
About JLL –
  
  
We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  
Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  
Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

title: Responsible AI Solution Risk Assessor
description:
**Overview**  

Are you passionate about advancing the positive impact of AI on a global scale? In this position, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring that our AI initiatives are implemented responsibly and effectively.

Our Trust and Integrity Protection (TrIP) team works with other parts of Microsoft to ensure we continue to be one of the most trusted companies in the world. We are seeking a detail-oriented and principled Responsible AI Solution Risk Assessor to be part of a team evaluating AI use cases across our organization. This role is critical in ensuring that AI solutions are developed and deployed in alignment with Microsoft’s Responsible AI principles, regulatory requirements, and ethical standards. You will work closely with the Office of Responsible AI and other governance bodies to identify, assess, and mitigate risks associated with AI technologies.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day, we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

  
**Responsibilities**  

* Risk Assessment Ownership: Lead the Responsible AI risk assessment process for AI projects within your purview.
* Use Case Evaluation: Analyze proposed AI solutions for ethical, privacy, and security risks, including identifying sensitive use cases (e.g., facial recognition, biometric analysis, or legally sensitive applications).
* Escalation Management: Determine when use cases require escalation to internal review boards such as the Deployment Safety Board or other governance entities.
* Approval Coordination: Ensure all necessary approvals are obtained before development or deal sign-off, maintaining alignment with internal Responsible AI policies.
* Documentation & Compliance: Maintain thorough documentation of risk assessments, approvals, and mitigation strategies to support audit readiness and compliance.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Collaborate with product teams, legal, compliance, and engineering to ensure risk considerations are addressed early in the development lifecycle.
* Policy Integration: Translate Responsible AI policies into actionable assessment criteria and workflows.
* Continuous Improvement: Contribute to the evolution of risk assessment frameworks and tools based on emerging technologies and regulatory changes.

  
**Qualifications**  

### **Required Qualifications (RQs)**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Ethics, Law, Risk Management, or a related field.
* 3+ years of experience in risk assessment, compliance, or governance roles, preferably in AI or emerging technologies.
* Familiarity with Responsible AI frameworks (e.g., NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act).
* Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
* Excellent communication and documentation abilities.
* Experience working with cross-functional teams in a matrixed organization.

### **Preferred Qualifications (PQs)**

* Bachelor's Degree in Risk Management, Engineering, Government Intelligence, Security, or Information Technology, or related field AND 5+ years experience in Risk Management in the context of Operations, Engineering, Information Technology, Business Analyst, Consulting, Auditing, Privacy, Security, Compliance, Government Intelligence, and/or Finance OR equivalent experience.
* Experience with internal governance processes such as AI review boards or safety panels.
* Knowledge of privacy-preserving technologies and bias mitigation techniques.
* Background in regulated industries (e.g., healthcare, finance, government).
* Certifications in AI ethics, compliance, or risk management.

  
  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process**.**

description:

Here you will collaborate with multi-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. In this role, you will own the autonomous operations layer, ensuring reliable, governed execution across 48 tier-one critical apps with sub-2h RTO, 45 databases, and 320 production environments spanning 12 countries.

**Responsibilities**

* Define and maintain the AI-driven monitoring and observability architecture for the SDP platform estate

* Provide technical governance on platform-layer changes, guardrails, and patterns for the low-code/no-code environment
* Serve as the technical interface to the SDP platform governance function

* Ensure SLA adherence, including P1 15 min/4 h, P2 30 min/8 h, with 24×7 coverage for highly critical applications

title: Deep Learning Research Engineer
description:
HackerRank helps companies like NVIDIA, Amazon, and Microsoft hire and upskill the next generation of developers based on skills, not pedigree. Our platform is trusted by over 2,500 of the world's most innovative companies to build strong engineering teams ready for what's next.  
  
Software has entered an era where humans and AI build side by side. As this shift accelerates, the definition of strong technical talent is changing. We give companies better ways to identify and invest in next-generation skills.  
  
People at HackerRank care deeply about the impact of their work and sweat the small details so our customers can be wildly successful with products they genuinely love to use. We move with urgency and believe great outcomes come from high standards.

#### **About the role**

Hiring is one of the most consequential decisions a company makes. 3,000+ enterprises rely on HackerRank to get it right. We are now reinventing how that works for the agentic era. The AI/ML systems that power this platform are not auxiliary features. They are the product.

#### **Open Problems**

The agentic era is reshaping every layer of the hiring stack. These are some of the core problems you'll be working across, none of them fully solved.

* **Chakra:** Building an autonomous AI interviewer that conducts, adapts to, and evaluates technical interviews end to end.
* **Integrity:** Detecting fraud and suspicious behavior across multiple signal types. The ways candidates game assessments change frequently, and the models need to keep up.
* **Evaluation:** Measuring technical skill in a world where AI writes the code. The old proxies no longer hold and the new ones have not been defined yet.

Your focus will shift across these depending on where the highest-leverage work is at any given time.

#### **What you will do**

* Research, Design, and Develop advanced Deep Learning models and novel Neural architectures.
* Explore architectures beyond Transformers, including State Space Models (SSMs), Liquid Neural Networks (LNNs), and Hybrid approaches.
* Design and implement Agentic AI systems, Recursive Reasoning Engines, and tool-augmented architectures.
* Fine-tuning of models using PEFT (e.g. LoRA, QLoRA etc.), and Knowledge Distillation.
* Optimize model Performance, Inference Efficiency, Latency, and Memory utilization.
* Design rigorous experiments, evaluation frameworks, and benchmarks to validate research hypotheses.
* Translate cutting-edge research into scalable, production-grade AI systems.

#### **Who you are**

* M.Tech./M.S./Ph.D. in AI/ML or related disciplines, preferably from a Tier 1 premier Research Institution.
* 2–3 years of experience in Deep Learning, Machine Learning, or Applied AI Research.
* Strong foundations in Linear Algebra, Probability, Statistics, Optimization, and Deep Learning algorithms.
* Proficient in frameworks like PyTorch/JAX, with hands-on model development experience.
* Demonstrated ability to implement, reproduce, and extend research papers, including building neural architectures from scratch.
* Familiarity with distributed computing, GPU acceleration, and scalable ML infrastructure.
* Strong understanding of experimental design, model evaluation, benchmarking, and statistical validation.
* Demonstrated research aptitude through publications, open-source contributions etc.

#### **Even better if you have**

* Publications at top venues (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL) or notable open-source contributions in model architectures or agentic systems.
* Experience with LLM evaluation, fraud or anomaly detection, or building systems where the "ground truth" is still being defined.
* Hands-on work taking models from research into low-latency, production inference, such as quantization, distillation, or serving optimization.

#### **You will thrive here if you**

* You enjoysolving open-ended research problems and challenging established assumptions.
* You prefer first-principles thinking and rigorous experimentation over simply applying existing models.
* You are excited to explore next-generation AI architectures beyond traditional Transformers.
* You thrive in a fast-paced environment with intellectual freedom, ownership, and direct collaboration with leadership.
* You are passionate about turning novel AI research into efficient, scalable, real-world systems.

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:

SymphonyAI Industrial is a global leader in Industrial AI, enabling manufacturers and asset-intensive enterprises to transform fragmented IT, OT, and edge data into real-time, contextual intelligence that improves uptime, throughput, and operational efficiency.

Build technical depth while providing dependable customer support across SymphonyAI Industrial products. The role also participates in the 24/7 on-call rotation and responds to assigned incidents within applicable service-level targets and escalation procedures.

========================

--------------------------------------------

* Receive, clarify, categorize, and troubleshoot customer requests through approved support channels.
* Perform L1 triage and resolve common L1 and L2 issues using documented procedures, known solutions, and guidance from senior engineers.
* Collect complete diagnostic information, reproduce issues when feasible, and escalate with a clear problem statement, evidence, customer impact, and actions already attempted.
* Maintain accurate ticket status, customer communications, time entries, resolution details, and handoff notes.

**Technical Investigation**
---------------------------

* Use foundational skills in SQL, Windows/Linux, application logs, networking concepts, and cloud services to investigate incidents.
* Execute approved diagnostic queries, scripts, and operational procedures without introducing avoidable risk.
* Support root cause analysis by gathering evidence, documenting observations, and validating corrective actions.

**Knowledge and Collaboration**
-------------------------------

* Create and update knowledge articles, troubleshooting notes, and customer-specific support documentation.
* Participate in team meetings, technical deep dives, shift handoffs, and product knowledge sessions.
* Support project transitions and hypercare activities by validating support readiness and reporting issues promptly.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* 2+ years of technical support, system administration, software operations, or comparable experience, including internships or equivalent practical experience.
* Working familiarity with SQL, one or more scripting or programming languages, Windows or Linux, and basic cloud concepts.
* Clear written and verbal communication, careful documentation habits, and willingness to ask for guidance.
* Ability to prioritize work, follow change and escalation controls, and learn multiple products and customer environments.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Exposure to Azure or AWS, Kubernetes or Docker, application performance monitoring, and ticketing platforms such as Azure DevOps, Zendesk, Jira, or ServiceNow.
* Azure Fundamentals, CompTIA, or ITIL Foundation certification.
* Interest in industrial software, manufacturing, IoT, or operational technology.

**Role Success and Growth**
===========================

* Progress is demonstrated through reliable ticket ownership, accurate diagnosis, complete documentation, safe execution, and increasing independence.
* Development path may include Technical Support Engineer 2, product specialization, project support, or other technical roles.

About Us:

SymphonyAI is building the leading enterprise AI SaaS company for digital transformation across the most critical and resilient growth industries, including retail, consumer packaged goods, financial crime prevention, manufacturing, media, and IT service management. Since its founding in 2017, SymphonyAI today serves 1500+ Enterprise customers globally and has grown to 3,000 talented leaders, data scientists, and other professionals across over 30 countries.

description:
**Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human**  
  
Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
  
  
This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

### **Company Description**

Okta is the leading independent provider of enterprise identity. The Okta Identity Cloud enables organizations to securely connect the right people to the right technologies at the right time. With over 6,500 pre-built integrations to applications and infrastructure providers, Okta customers can easily and securely use the best technologies for their business. Over 7,950 organizations, including 20th Century Fox, JetBlue, Nordstrom, Slack, Teach for America, and Twilio, trust Okta to help protect the identities of their workforces and customers.

### **Position Description**

We are seeking an experienced **Senior Software Engineer** to play a key role in building and scaling the **Okta Recovery Vault (ORV)**. This team is responsible for Okta's enterprise-grade soft-delete and object recovery capability, designed to protect critical identity objects (Users and Groups) from accidental or malicious deletion.

As a Senior Engineer, you will own the technical design, implementation, and operational reliability of critical components within our real-time, high-fidelity recovery system. You will solve complex engineering problems around identity preservation (UUIDs) and relationship restoration—including group memberships, app assignments, and password hashes—ensuring our customers can seamlessly recover from data loss events.

### **Job Duties and Responsibilities**

* **Feature Execution:** Drive the technical design and end-to-end implementation of complex features, such as granular and bulk recovery workflows across Free and Advanced Resilience tiers.
* **Component Design:** Design and build reliable core components for real-time recovery systems that capture deletion events and support scalable data restoration.
* **Relationship & State Management:** Solve challenging engineering problems around relationship restoration (group memberships, app assignments, device enrollments) and state consistency.
* **Security & Compliance:** Implement secure logging and tracking for all recovery operations (soft-delete, restore, permanent-delete) in Syslog to adhere to strict audit and compliance standards.
* **Product & Cross-Functional Alignment:** Partner with Product Managers and technical leads to clarify requirements, define technical scope, and break down complex projects into actionable milestones.
* **Operational Excellence:** Participate in on-call rotations, troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis (RCAs), and enhance system observability, logging, and metrics.
* **Code Quality & Technical Standards:** Champion engineering best practices through thorough code reviews, automated testing, and comprehensive technical documentation.
* **Team Growth:** Provide guidance and peer mentorship to intermediate and junior engineers on the team to foster technical growth and code quality.

### **Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* **Experience:** 5+ years of hands-on software engineering experience building and scaling highly reliable, production-grade applications.
* **Java Expertise:** Strong proficiency in object-oriented programming, with extensive experience in **Java** and the **Spring Boot** framework.
* **Distributed Systems:** Solid experience with distributed system patterns, asynchronous job processing, and event-driven architectures (essential for bulk restore operations).
* **Data Management:** Proficiency with relational databases (e.g., **MySQL**) and caching strategies (e.g., **Redis**) to manage state and high-throughput data snapshots.
* **API Design:** Proven experience designing, building, and maintaining robust **RESTful APIs** for enterprise integration.
* **Problem Solving & Ownership:** Proven track record of independently breaking down ambiguous requirements into clean, scalable software designs.

### **Nice to Haves**

* Familiarity with Identity and Access Management (IAM) standards (SCIM, SAML, OAuth, OIDC) or directory services (AD, LDAP).
* Experience with resilient systems design (e.g., retry strategies, circuit breakers, rate limiting).
* Hands-on experience with feature flagging frameworks and gradual/canary deployment strategies.
* Experience with queueing systems or message brokers (e.g., Kafka).

### **Education and Training**

* **B.S. or M.S.** in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).

description:
**Description**

  
  

**Invent the future with us.**

  
  
Ampere is a semiconductor design company for a new era, leading the future of computing with an innovative approach to CPU design focused on high-performance, energy efficient AI compute.

As a part of the Emulation Team at Ampere, you will be part of verification of the next generation of microprocessor cores on hardware emulation platform by developing and deploying new capabilities and test content to accelerate bug finding in pre-silicon.

**What you'll achieve:**

Your responsibilities may include, but are not limited to, the following:

* Be part of the emulation verification execution team and be responsible for planning, development, and execution of test content in varied domains including system stress, cache coherency and concurrency.
* Work in collaboration with design and architecture teams to root-cause failures using advanced debugging techniques.

* Strong software development experience in compiled (C/C++) and interpreted (Python, Tcl) languages

* Self-motivated engineer with passion for innovation and demonstrated out-of-box thinking is strongly required.

This role combines engineering leadership, technical strategy, people management, and delivery excellence to drive digital transformation.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead, mentor, and grow a high\-performing Automation \& AI engineering team.
* Establish engineering standards, best practices, and delivery governance.
* Own end\-to\-end delivery of enterprise automation solutions using UiPath and related technologies.
* Provide technical oversight for solution architecture, integrations, security, scalability, and production support.
* Collaborate with business, architecture, and platform teams to deliver measurable business outcomes.
* Build the roadmap for adopting Generative AI, Agentic AI, LLMs, and AI Agents within automation solutions.
* Partner with business stake holders in improving business outcomes using Automation and AI technologies
* Lead Proof of Concepts (PoCs), reusable frameworks, and engineering accelerators.
* Partner with AI/ML teams to integrate OpenAI, RAG, document intelligence, and AI\-powered workflows.
* Drive Agile, DevOps, CI/CD, quality engineering, and operational excellence.
* Manage engineering roadmaps, delivery plans, and cross\-functional stakeholder relationships.
* Hire, coach, and develop engineering talent while fostering a culture of innovation and continuous learning.

**Required Skills \& Experience**
---------------------------------

* 15\+ years in Software Engineering, Automation, or Enterprise Application Development.
* At least 5 years of experience in people management as an Engineering Manager or Sr Engineering Manager
* Proven experience in leading engineering teams delivering enterprise\-scale solutions.
* Strong hands\-on experience with UiPath RPA, including Orchestrator, AI Center, Action Center, Document Understanding, queues, assets, triggers, robots, and deployment management.
* Experience with Agile, DevOps, CI/CD, SDLC, and engineering governance.
* Exposure to Generative AI, LLMs, OpenAI, Agentic AI, RAG, and AI Agents is highly desirable.
* Excellent leadership, stakeholder management, communication, and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience conducting feasibility assessments, ROI analysis, process assessments, automation opportunity identification, and solution estimation.
* Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to translate business needs into practical, scalable, and value\-driven technical solutions.
* Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong leadership, stakeholder management, mentoring, documentation, and presentation skills.

**Success Profile**
-------------------


The ideal candidate is an engineering leader who can build and scale teams, drive enterprise automation delivery, and establish the technical foundation for future GenAI and Agentic AI capabilities, balancing technical excellence with business impact.

**Equal Opportunity Employer Statement**
----------------------------------------


Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

The MTS Software System Design Engineer will serve as a leader within the Release and Test Engineering Organization with **strong foundation of AI and Test automation leveraging AI.** This role will need to have a holistic view of development and validation workflows for systems products, strong background towards automation of CLI/UI test cases, have good understanding of CLI and UI automation tools/frameworks and augment test automation by being hands\-on. This role can involve leading a small team of test case development/automation engineers.

The ideal candidate would be self\-directed, quality\-focused, and hands\-on technical leader with **deep expertise in software validation, test architecture, automation, debugging, and quality engineering**. The candidate should have a strong understanding of H/W platform architectures and platform\-software interactions preferably with AMD platform architectures. He should have experience in translating product requirements into comprehensive validation coverage, and using AI for generation and improvement of tests, failure triage, defect prediction, and QA productivity.

* **10\+ years of relevant industry experience** in system validation, test strategy and design, test automation and defect management/release qualification.

* Experience of leading a small team in the above space would be a positive differentiator

Responsibilities:
**Job Purpose:**The ITOC Team Leader provides technical leadership for a 24x7x365 IT Operations Center responsible for monitoring, triage, incident coordination, escalation, communication and operational stability across network, infrastructure, cloud, security and business application environments. The role acts as the first point of technical command during production issues, drives timely restoration, ensures accurate stakeholder communication, maintains strong operational discipline and supports continual improvement through automation, runbook maturity, monitoring quality and service reliability metrics.

 **Key Responsibilities**

* **24x7 Monitoring \& Event Response:** Lead real\-time monitoring of critical IT services, infrastructure, circuits, servers, storage, virtualization, cloud platforms, security alerts and business applications.
* **Incident Command \& Coordination:** Act as shift\-level incident lead for major alerts or outages, coordinate technical bridges, assign investigation actions, track progress and drive issues toward restoration.
* **Technical Triage \& Troubleshooting:** Perform initial and advanced triage across network, Windows/Linux, virtualization, database, middleware, backup, storage and application layers before escalation.
* **Escalation Ownership:** Engage appropriate Level 2/Level 3 teams, vendors, exchanges, network providers and service owners, while continuing to own the incident until resolution or clear handover.
* **Business \& Stakeholder Communication:** Prepare clear operational updates, outage notifications, awareness messages and resolved communications for service owners, Service Desk and impacted business groups.
* **Shift Leadership \& Handover Quality:** Manage shift priorities, ensure clean shift handovers, maintain situational awareness of active incidents, planned maintenance, pending escalations and operational risks.
* **Runbook \& SOP Management:** Create, review and improve operational runbooks, escalation matrices, alert response procedures and knowledge articles to improve consistency across shifts.
* **Post\-Incident Review Support:** Contribute to incident timelines, impact summaries, root\-cause follow\-up, corrective actions and problem\-management tracking.
* **Operational Reporting \& Metrics:** Track and report key metrics such as alert volumes, incident trends, SLA adherence, MTTA, MTTR, recurring issues, handover quality and automation opportunities.
* **Monitoring Quality \& Alert Hygiene:** Identify noisy, duplicate or low\-value alerts and work with engineering teams to improve thresholds, coverage, routing and actionable alert design.
* **Automation \& Continuous Improvement:** Identify repetitive operational tasks suitable for automation using scripts, APIs, workflows or AI\-assisted tooling; support safe automation adoption with proper controls.
* **Team Mentoring \& KT:** Coach junior ITOC engineers, support onboarding, conduct knowledge\-transfer sessions and promote consistent troubleshooting and communication standards.
* **Change \& Maintenance Support:** Monitor planned changes, validate post\-change service health, support maintenance windows and raise concerns when service risk is observed.
* **Compliance \& Documentation Discipline:** Ensure incidents, escalations, evidence, actions and communications are documented accurately in tickets according to defined policies and SOPs.

**Experience:** 7\-10 years in ITOC/NOC/SOC, infrastructure operations, network operations, application operations or enterprise monitoring.

* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering or equivalent practical experience.
* **Technical Skills:** ITIL Foundation or higher; CCNA/CCNP; Good understanding of BGP; VMware; Linux/Windows administration certifications, F5 BIG\-IP
* **Tools \-** Datadog, servicenow, solarwinds
* **Domain Exposure:** Experience in financial services, regulated environments, global operations, follow\-the\-sun support and 24x7 support if required.

4 days in office per week

title: SOC - Detection Engineer
description:
At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life\-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R\&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.


**Your Role**
-------------


* Design, develop, and continuously improve detection use cases, analytics rules, correlation logic, anomaly detection models, threat hunting queries, dashboards, and watchlists across Microsoft Sentinel, Defender XDR, and related security platforms.
* Translate threat intelligence, incident findings, red/purple team outcomes, emerging threats, and business risks into prioritized detection requirements aligned with organizational security objectives and MITRE ATT\&CK coverage.
* Create, test, validate, tune, and maintain detection logic using KQL, Python, PowerShell, and detection\-as\-code methodologies while minimizing false positives and improving detection effectiveness.
* Collaborate with SOC, Data Onboarding, and Security Automation teams to ensure telemetry readiness, SOAR integration, operational validation, documentation, and successful production deployment of detections.
* Conduct threat hunting, attack emulation, behavioral analytics, and continuous detection coverage assessments while maintaining detection lifecycle governance, quality metrics, release management, and ongoing enhancements.
**Your Profile**
----------------


* 6\+ years of experience in Detection Engineering, Threat Hunting, and Security Analytics with demonstrated ownership of the end\-to\-end detection lifecycle, content validation, and cross\-domain threat detection capabilities.
* Strong expertise in Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender XDR, Azure Data Explorer (ADX), KQL, Python, PowerShell, and detection engineering best practices, including analytics development, tuning, testing, and operationalization of security content.
* Hands\-on experience with CI/CD, Git, Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC), Detection\-as\-Code, testing automation, content repositories, platform integrations, peer review processes, and detection release management within SOC environments.
* Experience working with Azure Data Explorer, Databricks, Jupyter/iPython Notebooks, MSTICPy, security data science, statistical/ML analytics, and data engineering concepts to develop and operationalize advanced hunting, anomaly detection, and behavioral analytics use cases.
* Proven experience with attack emulation and detection validation frameworks such as Atomic Red Team, Caldera, Prelude, AttackIQ, Sigma, YARA/YARA\-L, as well as fraud, identity, cloud, SaaS, OT, data leakage, and network anomaly detection use cases.
**What you will love working in Capgemini**
-------------------------------------------


* Design, develop, and continuously enhance detection use cases, analytics rules, correlation logic, anomaly detection models, threat hunting queries, dashboards, and watchlists using Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender XDR, and related security platforms.
* Create, validate, tune, and maintain detection logic using KQL, Python, PowerShell, and detection\-as\-code methodologies while reducing false positives and improving overall detection effectiveness.
* Clear career progression paths from engineering roles to architecture and consulting.
* Be part of mission\-critical projects that ensure security, compliance, and operational efficiency for Fortune 500 clients.

title: Industry Solution Leader - Oil, Gas & Chemical (Refining / Chemical Asset Performance)
description:
C3 AI (NYSE: AI), is the Enterprise AI application software company. C3 AI delivers a family of fully integrated products including the C3 Agentic AI Platform, an end\-to\-end platform for developing, deploying, and operating enterprise AI applications, C3 AI applications, a portfolio of industry\-specific SaaS enterprise AI applications that enable the digital transformation of organizations globally, and C3 Generative AI, a suite of domain\-specific generative AI offerings for the enterprise. Learn more at: **C3 AI**


C3 AI is seeking an Industry Solution Leader (ISL) for Oil, Gas \& Chemical to lead the design and delivery of enterprise AI solutions for its clients with a specialization in Refining / Chemical Asset Performance.



Industry Solution Leaders combine deep industry and engineering expertise with end\-to\-end ownership of customer solutions. They are expected to understand a customer's operations deeply enough to challenge assumptions, identify and quantify the highest\-value opportunities, define the right technical solution, and lead cross\-functional teams through design, deployment, validation, and scale.



The role combines the responsibilities of a senior domain expert and solution leader. Industry Solution Directors work directly with customer engineering, operations, maintenance, and executive teams while leading C3 AI Forward Deployed Engineers, data scientists, product teams, and other technical resources to deliver measurable business outcomes.



The ideal candidate brings significant hands\-on experience in engineering, manufacturing, operations, reliability, or maintenance and has the technical judgment, customer leadership, and delivery ownership required to lead complex enterprise AI solutions from problem definition through production.



The ISL, Oil, Gas \& Chemical \- Refining / Chemical Asset Performance should have **hands\-on experience working inside a refinery, chemical plant, or similar continuous\-process facility, including distillation, reactors, furnaces, compressors, heat exchangers, or utilities, with ownership of throughput, yield, energy, APC/process control, or reliability outcomes.**


**RESPONSIBILITIES**


* Own the overall solution strategy, technical direction, and delivery outcomes for assigned customer engagements, maintaining accountability from initial problem definition through production deployment and scale.
* Serve as the primary customer\-facing solution leader and domain expert, developing a detailed understanding of customer operations, equipment, processes, constraints, and business objectives.
* Identify and quantify high\-impact business opportunities across equipment reliability, maintenance, production performance, process optimization, throughput, yield, quality, energy efficiency, and operating economics.
* Translate complex engineering and operational challenges into tractable AI, machine learning, optimization, and software problems with clearly defined requirements, success criteria, and expected business value.
* Lead engagements through use case definition, requirements gathering, solution architecture, application configuration, validation, production deployment, user adoption, and scale\-out.
* Apply deep engineering and industry expertise to challenge assumptions, evaluate technical approaches, interpret analytical results, and ensure solutions are consistent with engineering fundamentals and operational realities.
* Lead cross\-functional teams of Forward Deployed Engineers, data scientists, product managers, engineers, and industry experts, establishing technical priorities and driving alignment around customer outcomes.
* Work directly with customer engineers, operators, reliability teams, maintenance organizations, and executives to validate requirements, solution performance, operational workflows, and business impact.
* Guide the interpretation and use of industrial data, including process signals, equipment attributes, operating states, maintenance history, production information, alarms, quality data, and other engineering information required to solve customer problems.
* Maintain accountability for solution quality, business value, technical risks, delivery progress, customer adoption, and executive communication throughout the engagement.
* Partner with C3 AI product management and engineering teams to identify reusable capabilities, inform product development, and scale successful solutions across assets, production lines, facilities, and business units.
* Support sales teams during opportunity assessment and capture by helping define customer problems, solution approaches, business value, technical requirements, deployment strategy, and demonstrations.
* Support development of statements of work and deployment plans, ensuring scope, deliverables, assumptions, data requirements, risks, timelines, and resource requirements are clearly defined.
* Develop repeatable industry methodologies, solution patterns, and best practices and represent C3 AI in relevant customer, industry, and technical forums.


**QUALIFICATIONS**


* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline. Mechanical, Chemical, Electrical, Industrial, Mining, Metallurgical, Petroleum, Materials, or similar engineering backgrounds are preferred.
* 7\+ years of experience in engineering, manufacturing, operations, reliability, maintenance, industrial technology, or technically focused consulting.
* Deep experience in one or more asset\-intensive industries, including high\-tech or semiconductor manufacturing, steel and metals, minerals and mining, utilities and power generation, oil and gas, chemicals, petrochemicals, LNG, pharmaceuticals, or heavy manufacturing.
* Demonstrated experience solving complex operational problems and improving equipment reliability, production performance, throughput, yield, quality, maintenance effectiveness, energy efficiency, or operating economics.
* Strong understanding of industrial equipment, manufacturing or production processes, process controls, maintenance practices, and operational workflows.
* Experience working with industrial data including sensor and time\-series data, equipment states, alarms, maintenance history, production data, laboratory or quality information, equipment hierarchies, and engineering data.
* Experience with industrial systems such as process historians, SCADA, DCS, MES, EAM/CMMS, ERP, advanced process control, or industrial analytics platforms.
* Demonstrated ability to reason from engineering fundamentals and determine whether analytical and AI\-driven recommendations are physically, technically, and operationally credible.
* Demonstrated experience leading complex, customer\-facing technical engagements and working directly with engineering, operational, and executive stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to structure ambiguous problems, establish priorities, and drive teams toward practical solutions.
* Ability to work effectively with software engineers, data scientists, product managers, and customer technical teams and translate between domain, business, and technical requirements.
* Excellent presentation, written communication, leadership, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to travel to customer locations as required.


**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**


* Experience delivering AI, machine learning, advanced analytics, optimization, predictive maintenance, condition monitoring, process optimization, or industrial digital transformation solutions.
* Hands\-on technical experience working with industrial data, SQL, Python, analytics tools, application configuration, scripting, or similar technologies, with the ability to directly inspect data, prototype analyses, and troubleshoot solution behavior.
* Experience with rotating equipment, electrical equipment, production equipment, manufacturing lines, process units, mining systems, utility assets, or other complex industrial systems.
* Experience taking technical solutions from initial proof of value through production deployment and scale.
* Experience scaling solutions across multiple assets, plants, facilities, or business units.
* Advanced degree in Engineering, Science, or a related technical discipline.
